l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: Kila sentensi pia inatumia simple past (rang, went out).

l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.c: although hutokea katikati ya sentensi tu
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: Katika sentensi sahihi ya mfano, although ilitumiwa mwanzoni kabisa mwa sentensi.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: despite ina maana kinyume cha although
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Maneno yote mawili yana maana ileile, ‘in spite of’.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.explain: although huongoza kiima + kitenzi, na despite huongoza nomino (au kirai nomino). Maana ni ileile.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Ni sentensi za mfano tu ambazo Although it was cold ni kishazi na Despite the cold ni kirai nomino ndizo sahihi, kwa hiyo hii ndiyo kanuni.
